text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While out to take a breather, I spotted two familiar faces.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No... It cannot be. You, actually arriving at the meetup spot on time!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huhhh? That's mighty rude of you, hey! Golshi-chan is an exemplary girl who keeps her promises, you hear?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Kgh, she threw me off pace right from the start, desu wa. But... that ends today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Today, I will show her that I am not one to simply be dragged around...!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, didn't you say you wanted to get new shoes?
Those number-one most popular shoes over there supposedly have killer specs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (There must be a trap with this pattern. Just to be safe, I shall try on the pair from the shelf next to it—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-What on earth is this rainbow flashing light!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Picking flashy party-animal shoes out of nowhere...
Is McQueen exhausted or something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: T-This time I will not fail, desu wa. If I assess the situation thoroughly and respond accordingly...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait, oh my? Where are we? Gold Ship-san, let us head back the way we ca—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: She is gone!? Wh-Whatever shall I do! Or rather, how do I get back to where I was...?

text_block_list.name: Facility Announcement
text_block_list.text:
'—This is a lost child announcement.
Mejiro McQueen-san, your companion is waiting for you at the lost and found counter.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This, this, THIS time for sure...! Gold Ship-san, I will not forgive you if you wander off from my side!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! You two are Mejiro McQueen-san and Gold Ship-san, right!?
I'm a huge fan of both of you...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heh, you've got great taste, kid!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text: You're always working hard in perfect sync! I'll keep cheering for your success in the future!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In... perfect sync...? While I would like to spend about an hour articulating my thoughts on that matter...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please do keep watching our future endeavors.
The greater your expectations, the greater our strides forward shall become, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (In the end, nothing actually happened... or rather, I was just overthinking and running in circles all on my own, desu wa...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ahh, that was a blast. Getting hungry, so let's head back soon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Wait.
You still have places you wish to visit, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Someone like you who can't breathe unless
she's constantly moving like a tuna
could never be satisfied so easily, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It is unlike you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall properly keep you company,
so speak up and say it.
...Within the bounds of common sense, of course!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: McQueen...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Look at you talking big!
Alright then, let's head to――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: OUTER SPACE!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why on earth would I accompany you there...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saw the two of them everywhere I went today...
Seeing how surprisingly in sync they were brought a warm smile to my face.
